question: Gobinda Chandra Pal is an awardee of the Sangeet Natak Akademi Amrit Award for the year 2022. He contributed to the field of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi Dance (Gotipua)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gobinda Chandra Pal** is an awardee of the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Amrit Award** for the year **2022**.
 
• He has made significant contributions to the field of **Odissi Dance (Gotipua)**.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Amrit Award is a prestigious recognition given to individuals for their outstanding contributions to Indian performing arts.
 
• **Odissi Dance** is one of the classical dance forms of India, originating from the state of Odisha.
 
• **Gotipua** is a traditional dance form from Odisha, where young boys dress up as women to perform the dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Sangeet Natak Akademi** is India's national academy for music, dance, and drama. It was established in **1952** by the Government of India.
 
• The Akademi's primary objectives include the promotion and preservation of the performing arts in India.
 
• In addition to the Amrit Award, the Sangeet Natak Akademi also confers other awards such as the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar, and the Tagore Ratna.
 
• The **Gotipua** dance tradition has been a significant part of the Odissi dance heritage and has influenced the classical dance form of Odissi.
